name: HG Insights
summary: Technographics and IT spend intelligence: which products and vendors a company has installed, its IT spend by category, firmographics, corporate hierarchy, intent signals and contracts.

api_key.description: An HG Insights v2 API key (admin.hginsights.com > Settings > API Keys, admin only; starts hg_v2_). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Needs an HG Platform subscription with credits. Enrich, hierarchy, intent and contract calls spend credits by the data returned; match, search, catalog and credits are free but need a positive balance. Out of credits answers 402.
Re-enriching the same company within the 12-month contract is free; intent calls are charged every time.
Rate limits by plan: Sandbox 2 requests a second and 1,000 a day, Standard 25 a second and 50,000 a day. A batch counts as one request. 429 comes with x-ratelimit-reset.
Company ids are hex strings; get them from hg-insights.companies.match or search, or pass domains.

endpoints.name: Match companies
endpoints.summary: HG company records for up to 10 companies given by name, domain and/or country, best match first, in input order.

companies.description: 1-10 companies, each with at least one of name, domain, country (name or ISO alpha-2), and an optional customer_id echoed back.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Free.

endpoints.name: Enrich companies
endpoints.summary: Firmographics, installed technologies, IT spend, contracts and other data groups for up to 25 companies.

companies.description: The companies: {"ids": [hex HG ids]} or {"domains": [...]}, up to 25, never both.

fields.description: Data groups to return: firmographics, technographics, spend, ai_spend, contracts (needs the contracts entitlement), ai_maturity, cloud_maturity, mentions, statistics, market_benchmarks.

filters.description: Optional filters per group, e.g. {"technographics": {"vendors": {"names": ["Salesforce"]}, "product_categories": {"names": ["CRM"]}, "country": {"codes": ["US"]}}}; spend, ai_spend and mentions take their own filters.

pagination.description: Paging of the nested technographics, spend, ai_spend and mentions lists.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Spends credits by the groups asked for and the data found; estimate first with hg-insights.companies.enrich_estimate.

endpoints.name: Estimate an enrichment's credits
endpoints.summary: The maximum credits an enrich request would spend, the balance, and whether it suffices, without returning data.

companies.description: The companies: {"ids": [hex HG ids]} or {"domains": [...]}, up to 25, never both.

fields.description: Data groups to return: firmographics, technographics, spend, ai_spend, contracts (needs the contracts entitlement), ai_maturity, cloud_maturity, mentions, statistics, market_benchmarks.

filters.description: The same filters as the enrich call.

pagination.description: The same paging of nested technographics, spend, ai_spend and mentions lists as the enrich call.

contracts.description: The same contracts options as the enrich call: filters (active_only, vendor_names up to 10), limit and offset per company.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Free. Send the same body as the enrich call.

endpoints.name: Search companies
endpoints.summary: Companies matching firmographic, installed-product, spend, intent, hierarchy, AI-maturity or scoring filters.

fields.description: Fields to return: id, name, domain, domain_normalized.

filters.description: Filter groups: firmographics (country_codes, employees, revenue, industries, naics_codes, sic_codes, company_level, ...), installs (products, vendors, product_categories), spend, ai_spend, intent, corporate_hierarchy, company_identifiers, scoring. List items take {"ids": [...], "inclusion_method": "ANY_PRESENT"}.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Free. Results stop at 25,000 per query: segment with filters. Vendor and product ids come from hg-insights.products.search and hg-insights.catalog.vendors.

endpoints.name: Get corporate hierarchy
endpoints.summary: A company's corporate family as a tree or flat list: the whole group, its children, or its parents up to the group HQ.

mode.description: full (whole group from the group HQ), children (below the company) or parents (chain up to the group HQ).

format.description: tree (default) or list; the countries, regions and tiers filters need list.

filters.description: Optional: countries, regions, tiers (list format only), max_tier (both formats).

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Spends credits by the data returned.

endpoints.name: Get intent signals
endpoints.summary: Topic-based intent and buyer-intent activities for one company.

company.description: The company: {"id": hex HG id} or {"domain": ...}, exactly one.

fields.description: Sections: summary, topics, activities; summary alone is free.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow the results.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Charged per topic and activity record returned, on every call; ask for fields ["summary"] first for a free overview.

endpoints.name: Get technology usage over time
endpoints.summary: Monthly usage intensity per product for one company, as dense time series.

company.description: The company: {"id": hex HG id} or {"domain": ...}, exactly one.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.

endpoints.name: Search the product catalog
endpoints.summary: Products HG tracks, with vendor and category, by name and other filters.

filters.description: Product filters; vendor_id/vendor_ids and category_id/category_ids are mutually exclusive.

notes: A read sent as POST with a JSON body: it looks data up and changes nothing.
Free.

endpoints.name: List technology vendors
endpoints.summary: Vendors in HG's catalog, optionally by name, with their ids.
notes: Free.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credit balance, contract dates and data entitlements of the organisation.
notes: Free.
